notes: Conflict: the Republic here says Allen 'did not show at East St. Louis' on Oct. 28, but the Globe-Democrat (article 493) says Allen had just come back from down below that night. The 'bloody go' quote is not legible here (printed 'bloody gu'), so it is left out. Eagan's arrest and Chambers's escape do not concern Allen and are left out.
